name: Multi-Family Circles Manager
description: Multi-family circle scope manager handling active circle switching, AppPrefsHelper persistence, and cross-circle cache invalidation.
behavior_summary: Singleton holding active mCurrentFamilyScope, managing circle membership switching, and purging stale entity caches.

reusability_assessment.notes: Architectural model for Family OS multi-family circles system S1-01.

name: iCalendar RFC 5545 Recurrence Engine
description: Calendar recurrence computation engine based on ical4j RFC 5545 specification supporting daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly recurring patterns.
behavior_summary: Parses VEvent entities, generates occurrence expansions according to RRule, ExDate, and RDate, mapping them to EventBean instances.

reusability_assessment.notes: Direct reference for Family OS shared family calendar S1-03.

name: Android Native SyncAdapter Framework
description: System-level Android SyncAdapter framework orchestrating two-way calendar and contacts synchronization with local device databases.
behavior_summary: Extends AbstractThreadedSyncAdapter, binding with CalendarContract and ContactsContract for battery-efficient background sync.

reusability_assessment.notes: Foundational pattern for Family OS offline synchronization engine S1-02.

name: Shared Lists & Grocery Quantity Parser
description: Intelligent grocery quantity parsing and measurement unit normalization engine.
behavior_summary: Decomposes freeform text entries into numeric quantity, measurement unit, and ingredient name using UnitRegistry dictionaries.

reusability_assessment.notes: Blueprint for Family OS shared grocery lists and tasks S1-04.

name: Geotracking & Geofencing Location Engine
description: Continuous foreground location tracking and safe zone geofencing engine with battery-aware GPS provider monitoring.
behavior_summary: Operates foregroundServiceType='location' service with FusedLocationProviderClient and processes safe zone entry/exit events.

reusability_assessment.notes: Direct reference for Family OS safety radar and child tracking S1-06.

name: Family Wall & Realtime Messaging
description: Family social feed Activity and Fragment subsystem supporting chronological message lists, audio playback, and photo attachments (realtime server push unverified; polling/REST observed).
behavior_summary: Renders chronological family posts, threaded comments, audio message playback, and media upload queueing via standard HTTP/FIZ APIs.

reusability_assessment.notes: Functional blueprint for Family OS private family feed S1-07.

name: Family Document Vault (Filer)
description: Family document organizing subsystem (Filer) composed of 76 classes with folder hierarchies and category grouping (at-rest encryption unverified in APK; standard local storage observed).
behavior_summary: Categorizes family documents (insurance, IDs, medical) with folder hierarchies and role-based viewing permissions stored in local SQLite/filesystem.

reusability_assessment.notes: Key design model for Family OS document vault S1-08.

name: School Timetables & Alternating Weeks
description: Student school timetable manager supporting alternating multi-week rotations (Week A / Week B) and class scheduling.
behavior_summary: Manages recurring periods, subject color coding, instructor details, and alternating week schedules for children.

reusability_assessment.notes: Core architecture model for Family OS student timetables S1-05.

name: Birthday & Anniversary Tracker
description: Anniversary and birthday milestone countdown tracker with gift idea lists and automated annual reminders.
behavior_summary: Computes countdown days to upcoming family milestones, tracks gift suggestions, and dispatches reminder notifications.

reusability_assessment.notes: Reference for Family OS family milestone alerts S1-03.

name: Panic SOS & Family Shout Emergency Subsystem
description: Emergency distress broadcast subsystem initiating audible siren alerts, persistent notifications, and rapid GPS broadcast.
behavior_summary: Displays cancellation countdown timer, invokes PanicOngoingNotificationJobIntentService, and broadcasts SOS alerts to all circle members.

reusability_assessment.notes: Essential pattern for Family OS emergency assistance S1-06.

name: Child Account Access & Governance
description: Parental authorization and kid account onboarding flow providing supervised access to family feeds and schedules.
behavior_summary: Manages child account creation through parental email verification; Level B models specify PIN-based local lock mechanisms.

reusability_assessment.notes: Foundation for Family OS kid profile governance S1-01.

name: Android Application Manifest & Identity
description: Core application descriptor defining package com.familywall, 43 declared permissions, 249 architectural components, and deep link intents.
behavior_summary: Establishes Android OS component registration, deep link routing for 10 URL endpoints, and security permission boundaries.

reusability_assessment.notes: Direct architectural reference for Family OS Android container and manifest.

name: SQLite Local Database Schema (11 Tables)
description: Relational SQLite local database schema modeling circles, members, calendar events, tasks, lists, messages, and geozones.
behavior_summary: Defines relational entities supporting offline caching, transactional consistency, and multi-family data isolation.

reusability_assessment.notes: Relational schema baseline for Family OS local SQLite persistence S1-01 and S1-02.

name: Sanitized REST & Media Web Services API Catalog
description: Verified backend endpoints catalog targeting production api.familywall.com, media storage, map services, and development preprod environments.
behavior_summary: Maps verified API endpoints from decompiled Java constants, eliminating all foreign HTML/CSS and XML namespace artifacts.

reusability_assessment.notes: Clean-room reference for Family OS cloud sync REST APIs S1-01.

name: Design System Assets (Colors, Lottie, Audio)
description: Visual and auditory asset collection containing 1,341 theme color keys, 41 animated Lottie files, 1,137 vector drawables, and 5 audio sound effects.
behavior_summary: Provides comprehensive color palettes, micro-interaction feedback animations, and notification earcons.

reusability_assessment.notes: Direct asset feeding for Family OS design system S1-09 upon project owner approval.

name: Task Ordering & Categorized Lists Engine
description: Reorderable task and task list writeback cache synchronization engine utilizing midpoint-based numeric ordering.
behavior_summary: Calculates dynamic sortingIndex using midpoint-based numeric integer bisection between neighbor items, syncing changes via writeback cache operation to backend.

reusability_assessment.notes: Blueprint for Family OS task reordering and list drag-and-drop prioritization S1-04.
